name: Red Branch

attributes.attribute: warrior band that served in Leinster
sent the invading army of Connacht

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Red Branch is an Irish group of warriors. The band defended the northern province of Ulster, much as the Fianna later served Leinster. Its most famous member was Cuchulainn. He repelled the army that queen Medb of Connacht sent. Some scholars read the Red Branch tales as a faint picture of the Arthurian knights of the Round Table. The Red Branch Cycle points readers to the Ulster Cycle.
